# Scenario: soft TTL expiry with live PEMs + prod cache still present must
# re-issue via ACME (not restore from .certs.json). Guards the old bug where
# NotAfter kept restore forever and reset the soft TTL clock.
# Soft TTL is expired by backdating issued_at in ~/.certs.json (no wall sleep).

pebble-start

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: prod soft TTL reissue fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

exec apinfra
stderr 'obtaining domain=e2e-renew.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-renew.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-renew.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/.certs.json
grep '"active_mode": "prod"' $HOME/.certs.json
grep '"certificate":' $HOME/.certs.json
cp $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-renew.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem $WORK/prod-fullchain-before.pem

# Leave live PEMs and prod PEM cache in place; only age issued_at past soft TTL:
# issued_at = now - (cert-update-time-sec + 30m). 5184000 = default prod update window.
exec go run ./age_certs_issued.go $HOME/.certs.json e2e-renew.apinfra.test 5184000

# Quiet cycle (conf unchanged): ACME needs proxyReadyAfter. Template sets 1s.
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH
exec apinfra
stderr 'obtaining domain=e2e-renew.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-renew.apinfra.test mode=prod'
! stderr 'restored prod cert from cache'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-renew.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
grep 'prod' $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-renew.apinfra.test/.issued-mode
! exec cmp $WORK/prod-fullchain-before.pem $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-renew.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

pebble-stop

-- age_certs_issued.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "usage: age_certs_issued <certs.json> <domain> <cert-update-time-sec>\n")
		os.Exit(2)
	}

	path, domain := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	updateSec, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Args[3], 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("cert-update-time-sec: %w", err))
	}
	if updateSec <= 0 {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("cert-update-time-sec must be > 0, got %d", updateSec))
	}

	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}

	var doc map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}

	certs, ok := doc["certificates"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("missing certificates object"))
	}

	entry, ok := certs[domain].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("missing domain %s", domain))
	}

	byType, ok := entry["certs"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("missing certs map for %s", domain))
	}

	ageBy := time.Duration(updateSec)*time.Second + 30*time.Minute
	aged := time.Now().UTC().Add(-ageBy).Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	for name, rawType := range byType {
		typeCert, ok := rawType.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			fatal(fmt.Errorf("certs.%s is not an object", name))
		}
		typeCert["issued_at"] = aged
		byType[name] = typeCert
	}

	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	out = append(out, '\n')

	if err := os.WriteFile(path, out, 0o600); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "age_certs_issued: %v\n", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
proxyReadyAfter=1s
certs.provider=zerossl
certs.zerossl.AcmeKid=kid-1
certs.zerossl.AcmeHmac=zWNDZM6eQGHWpSRTPal5eIUYFTu7EajVIoguysqZ9wG44nMEtx3MUAsUDkMTQ12W
certs.zerossl.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-renew.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'
